title: Customer Operations Manager: Prozesse, Intercom, KI (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Käsmayr GmbH
description_html:
Heizung-Billiger ist in wenigen Jahren zu einem der beliebtesten Online-Marktplätze für Haustechnik, Sanitär und Heiztechnik geworden. Wir bieten Privat- und Geschäftskunden ein umfangreiches Sortiment aus den Bereichen Heizung, Badezimmer, Klima, Pumpen u.v.m. – ausschließlich Qualitätsware von Premium-Herstellern für Bestands- und Neubau. Damit schaffen wir moderne Bezugsmöglichkeiten in einem Schlüsselmarkt der Energiewende.

Wir entwickeln unsere Software selbst: Shop, ERP und Warenwirtschaft entstehen im eigenen Team. Der Kundenservice ist dabei kein Cost Center, sondern das Herzstück – und wir wollen ihn in den nächsten 12 Monaten grundlegend neu aufstellen. Dafür suchen wir Dich!

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unseren Kundenservice – fachlich, prozessual und technisch. Du arbeitest mit dem bestehenden Service-Team, gestaltest die Prozesse zu Endkunden und Lieferanten neu und bringst KI-gestützte Automatisierung in den Alltag. Gleichzeitig bist Du die Stimme des Kundenservice gegenüber unserer Softwareentwicklung.

Deine Projekte im ersten Jahr

  • Migration von Freshdesk auf Intercom. Du planst und verantwortest den Umzug unseres Ticketsystems: Datenübernahme, Inboxes, Workflows, Makros, Reporting. Anschließend konfigurierst Du Intercom so, dass Standardanfragen (Lieferstatus, Rechnungen, Auftragsänderungen, Retouren) autonom durch KI-Agenten gelöst werden.
  • Lieferanten-Retourenportal. Ein Konzept liegt in Teilen vor. Du führst es zu Ende, stimmst es mit unseren Lieferanten ab, begleitest die Umsetzung durch unser Entwicklerteam und rollst es im Key Account Management aus.
  • Prozess-Neuaufbau im Service. Du analysierst alle Prozesse zu Endkunden (Anfrage, Bestellung, Reklamation, Retoure) und zu Lieferanten (Rückfragen, Gewährleistung, Ersatzteile, Retouren), definierst Zielprozesse mit klaren SLAs und setzt sie mit dem Team um.

Deine laufenden Aufgaben

  • Technische Weiterentwicklung des Kundenservice-Teams
  • Product Owner für Service-Features in ERP und Warenwirtschaft: Anforderungen aus dem Service in User Stories übersetzen, priorisieren, mit der Entwicklung abstimmen, abnehmen
  • Aufbau und Pflege von KPIs (Lösungsquote der KI, First Response Time, CSAT, Retourenquote) und Ableitung von Maßnahmen
  • Ansprechpartner für Key Accounts und Lieferanten bei prozessualen Themen
  • Bei Bedarf Bearbeitung komplexer Kundenfälle als Eskalationsstufe
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Service-Erlebnis für alle B2C- und B2B-Kunden

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Kundenservice oder Customer Success im E-Commerce, davon mindestens einige Jahre mit Prozess- oder Teamverantwortung
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit Intercom – idealerweise hast Du bereits eine Migration verantwortet und Fin/Workflows/Custom Actions eingerichtet
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Serviceautomatisierung: Du weißt, wie man Anfragen klassifiziert, Wissensbasen aufbaut, Function Calls an Backend-Systeme anbindet und Automatisierungsgrade misst und steigert
  • Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Softwareentwicklung (Anforderungsmanagement, Backlog, Abnahme) – oder die klare Motivation, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen
  • Erfahrung mit Lieferanten- und Retourenprozessen, gerne im technischen Handel oder B2B
  • Strukturiertes, analytisches Arbeiten: Du denkst in Prozessen, Daten und Schnittstellen, nicht in Einzelfällen
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englisch für Tool-Dokumentationen und Hersteller-Kontakte
  • Wünschenswert: Kenntnisse in Haustechnik/SHK, Erfahrung mit ERP-/Warenwirtschaftssystemen, Grundverständnis von APIs und Datenmodellen

Benefits

Das bieten wir

  • Ein Mandat mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust den Kundenservice neu auf, nicht ab
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung und eigenem Entwicklerteam – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen
  • Budget für Tools und Weiterbildung (Intercom, KI, Prozessmanagement)
  • Attraktive Vergütung entsprechend der Verantwortung und Arbeitserfahrung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Tägliche Essenszulage für die Kantine vor Ort (SAP)
  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle in einem stark wachsenden Markt
  • Ein Team mit flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen Arbeitsatmosphäre

Interesse?

Schick uns Deine Bewerbung mit einer kurzen Vorstellung – und gern zwei, drei Sätze dazu, wie Du eine Ticketsystem-Migration oder eine KI-Automatisierung im Service schon einmal angegangen bist. Auch wenn nicht jeder Punkt zu 100 % passt: Wir sind gespannt auf Dich!

description_html:
Wir sind HolDeinePlakette, das schnellstwachsende Ingenieurbüro Deutschlands - spezialisiert auf die Durchführung von Haupt- und Abgasuntersuchungen gemäß §29 StVZO sowie auf Schadensgutachten.

Als renommiertes Ingenieurbüro mit 19 erfolgreichen Standorten und 80+ Kollegen stehen wir für Verlässlichkeit, Qualität und verantwortungsvolles Handeln.

Derzeit auf dem Prüfstand: Dein aktueller Job!

Aufgaben

Strategie:

  • Du verantwortest die Performance eines Prüfstellen-Clusters in der Region Stuttgart/Baden-Wüttenberg (Umsatz, Qualität, Team, Kundenzufriedenheit).

Leadership & Team

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung der PIs und PAs in deiner Region.
  • Recruiting, Onboarding und Weiterentwicklung deiner Teammitglieder.
  • Klare Vision, regelmäßige 1:1s, Feedback und Coaching.
  • Aufbau einer leistungsstarken, stabilen und motivierten Teamkultur.

Operative Steuerung & KPIs

  • Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe an allen Prüfstellen (Auslastung, Durchsatz, Wartezeiten).

  • Operativer Support vor Ort, z.B. bei Krankheits- oder Urlaubsfällen.

Kunde & Markt

  • Sicherung einer top Service-Experience für B2C- und B2B-Kunden.
  • Aktiver Ausbau von Bestandskunden und Gewinnung neuer Key-Partner in der Region.
  • Monitoring von NPS, Bewertungen, Beschwerden und Einleiten von Maßnahmen.

Unternehmerische Verantwortung

  • Identifikation von Wachstumshebeln und Prozessverbesserungen, enge Abstimmung mit HQ (COO, Expansion, GTM, Product, People, Finance).

  • Du führst und entwickelst das Team aus Prüfingenieuren (PIs) und Prüfassistenten (PAs).
  • Du kombinierst operative Arbeit als Prüfingenieur mit klarer Führungs- und Steuerungsverantwortung.

Qualifikation

  • Qualifikation: Abgeschlossene Fortbildung zum Kfz-Prüfingenieur (z.B. via KÜS, TÜV, GTÜ, Dekra)
  • Fachwissen: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als KfZ-Prüfingenieur, idealerweise erste Führungs- oder Standortverantwortung.
  • Führerscheine: Klassen A, B und CE und Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Region BW.
  • Engagement: Starkes Verständnis für KPIs und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, Lust auf Ownership für Umsatz & Bottom-Line.
  • Gutes Auftreten, klare Kommunikation, Deutsch C2.
  • Stil: Hands-on, pragmatisch, aber mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.

Benefits

  • Sehr attraktive Vergütung mit lukrativem Bonusmodell: stabiles Fixgehalt & Umsatzbeteiligung an allen Prüfstellen des Clusters.
  • Verantwortung und flache Hierarchien: Rolle mit echter unternehmerischer Verantwortung in einem schnell wachsenden Ingenieurbüro.
  • Jobauto inkl. Tankkarte: Fahre dein Traumauto über unseren Partner Jobauto zu unschlagbaren Konditionen via Gehaltsumwandlung & profitiere von unserer unlimitierten Tankkarte.
  • Firmenfitness: Bleib fit & gesund mit dem Egym Wellpass und Zugang zu über 10.000 Fitnessstudios.
  • 30 Urlaubstage: Mehr Zeit für dich und deine Erholung.
  • Firmenhandy: Damit du Beruf und Privates flexibel trennen kannst.
  • Hochwertige Arbeitskleidung: Fühl dich jeden Tag gut und sicher an deinem Arbeitsplatz mit Kleidung von u.a. Engelbert Strauss.
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents: Regionale & überregionale Events mit deinen Kollegen.
  • Vielzahl an Standorten: Wir betreiben bereits diverse Prüfstellen in Nürnberg, Frankfurt und Regensburg und expandieren nach NRW & BaWü.
  • Modernes, digitales Arbeitsumfeld: Wir denken KfZ-Prüfung neu - von digitalem Hol und Bring Service über Echtzeit Daten an der Prüfstelle.

Du hast Lust auf eine spannende Herausforderung im Bildungsbereich? Du möchtest Teil eines dynamischen Teams sein und den digitalen Wandel aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Für unsere AI & Learning Design Abteilung suchen wir dich als Erfahrenen Software Engineer / ML Engineer (m/w/x).

Wir suchen eine:n erfahrene:n Software Engineer:in für die Entwicklung produktnaher Anwendungen im Bildungsbereich, mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Backend, Infrastruktur und tragfähiger Softwarearchitektur. Machine Learning, LLMs und datengetriebene Funktionen spielen eine wichtige Rolle, sollen aber pragmatisch und nutzerorientiert eingesetzt werden. Die Position richtet sich an Personen mit belastbarer Projekterfahrung, nicht an rein akademisch oder theoretisch geprägte Profile.

Dein Einsatzort ist hauptsächlich remote innerhalb von Deutschland, wir unterstützen flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle.

Aufgaben

  • ILP aufbauen: Du besprichst mit dem PO die nächsten Schritte der Weiterentwicklung und arbeitest erfolgreich mit den Kollegen am Aufbau der Plattform.

  • ILP-Weiterentwicklung mitdenken: Du bist involviert in die Requests zur Weiterentwicklung und verantwortest deren technische Umsetzung in der Software.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit IT Du arbeitest mit allen Stellen, die zum Betrieb der Software nötig sind, professionell zusammen.
  • Technische Verantwortung: Du übernimmst Verantwortung im Aufbau des Technologiestacks.

Qualifikation

  • Beruflicher Hintergrund: Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise mit mehreren produktiv eingesetzten Anwendungen oder Plattformen. Wünschenswert wäre Erfahrung mit LLM-basierten Produktfunktionen, Prompting, Retrieval-Systemen oder mehrstufigen KI-Workflows sowie Software-Entwicklungserfahrung aus der Zeit vor dem aktuellen GenAI-Boom, mit entsprechendem Blick für Wartbarkeit, Architektur und realistische Produktreife.
  • Fachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python sowie fundierte Erfahrung mit Backend-Entwicklung, z. B. Ruby on Rails, Django, FastAPI oder vergleichbaren Frameworks. Du hast Erfahrung mit Cloud- und Infrastrukturthemen wie Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Terraform, AWS oder Azure und eine nachweisbare Praxis in der Umsetzung von ML-, NLP- oder datenbasierten Anwendungen, z. B. Klassifikation, RAG, Embeddings, Pipelines oder Modellintegration. Erfahrung in fachlich komplexen Domänen wie Bildung, Didaktik, Wissensmanagement, Healthcare, Data Platforms oder regulierten Umfeldern wäre wünschenswert.
  • Methodik: Du hast eine eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch, guter Auffassungsgabe und sicherer Kommunikation im Team sowie mit Fachbereichen.
  • Persönliche Fähigkeiten: Du hast Erfahrung in technischer Führung, Mentoring, Architekturentscheidungen oder enger Zusammenarbeit mit Product Ownern und Stakeholdern, was dir den Einstieg erleichtert.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, die es dir ermöglichen, effektiv zu kommunizieren

Benefits

  • Mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands
  • Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell
  • 6 Wochen Urlaub im Jahr
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: attraktive Preisnachlässe bei unterschiedlichen Anbietern

  • Jobrad
  • Wellpass
  • Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket
  • Bildschirmarbeitsplatzbrille
  • Gruppenunfallversicherung

Bei uns erwartet dich ein vorurteilsfreies, wertschätzendes Miteinander. Wir leben Vielfalt – sowohl mit unseren Teilnehmer:innen als auch im GFN-Team.

title: Founding Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at 1zu100 GmbH
description_html:
Build the future of architecture

1zu100 is automating construction planning. Together with exceptional architecture firms, we plan multi-unit residential buildings and deliver completed, permitted plans as a service.

TL;DR

We are looking for one cracked founding engineer to build the AI that plans large residential buildings end to end: the agent harness, the data and context layer, and the evals. You work in a small, high-agency team on real projects that ship right away.

The core of the role

  • Harness engineering: You build and run the layer around the model end to end: memory, tool orchestration, verification, drawing and document generation, so the output stays consistent and code-compliant at scale.

  • Data and context: You turn messy planning data (CAD/BIM models, PDFs, site surveys, building codes) into the right context at every phase, always traceable back to its source.

  • Evals and benchmarks: You build the eval harness (datasets, regression tests) and measure our agents against the architectural rule sets and judgment calls.

  • BIM and IFC automation: You connect to the architect's toolchain (Revit, ArchiCAD, IFC) to drive automated modeling and clean interoperability.

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on experience with harness engineering: agents, tool orchestration, evals.

  • High agency and an entrepreneurial drive. Ideally you have founded before or want to. You find the work yourself and move fast.

  • Experience in a high-growth environment (startup, scale-up or similar).

  • Nice to have: German, Revit, IFC or Grasshopper, a non-linear CV and experiments with reinforcement learning (MCTS, GRPO, RLHF) or diffusion models (discrete and continuous).

What we offer

  • A fast-paced environment at a fast-growing startup, with a steep learning curve

  • Competitive salary and a stake in the company, with first-hire upside

  • Real projects that ship right away

  • You build right alongside the founders, in the same codebase on the same hard problems

  • Wellpass and unlimited coffee from a professional barista

We're a small team with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and change the way construction planning is done, you're the one we need.

How we hire

  1. Apply here.

  2. An intro call with the founders.

  3. A technical interview.

  4. A trial day on-site in Munich. We pick a problem together and build it side by side.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: Working Student - Returns Management (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Quantum-Systems GmbH
description_html:
As a Working Student in Repair & Service Coordination, you will be a key part of our team to ensure smooth and efficient repair and service processes for our customers. Together with our world-class team, you will take an empowering role in supporting our operations and customer service.

You will work closely with Customer Support, Repair, and Fulfillment to coordinate repairs, system returns, and customer requests. By ensuring reliable processes and continuously improving our service quality, your mission will have a powerful impact at Quantum Systems.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Returns Management:  
    Assist the team to coordinate with the customers to return systems or subsystems for repair and maintenance. 

  • Documentation

    Documentation and control of incoming and outgoing system configurations in existing configuration databases. 

  • Repair Coordination:  
    Assist the team to coordinate between the customer and the repair team to communicate and monitor repair timelines. 

  • Compensation Management: 

    Coordinate compensation shipments with the customer, Tier 1 support and the fulfilment team. 

  • Ticket Management: 
    Handle and monitor repair tickets in Jira Service Management and provide structured documentation.

  • Ongoing Learning and Product Knowledge: 
    Stay up to date on new components and products to ensure 

  • Continuous Improvement: 
    Contribute to internal process enhancements that increase efficiency and service quality. 

  • Customer Issue Resolution: 
    Take ownership of customer complaints and escalations, drive resolution in coordination with internal teams.



What you bring to the team:

  • You are studying management, logistics, supply chain management, production or a related field. 

  • You are a strong communicator who is comfortable working with customers as well as coordinating across Support, Repair, Fulfillment, and other internal teams. 

  • You have a structured and reliable working style, keeping track of multiple repair cases, priorities, timelines, system configurations, and stakeholders simultaneously. 

  • You are customer-oriented and solution-driven, especially when handling complaints, escalations, or time-critical service requests. 

  • You enjoy working in a fast-paced and evolving environment and are motivated to continuously improve processes, workflows, and service quality. 

  • You are a collaborative and dependable team player who contributes to smooth day-to-day operations and builds strong relationships across teams. 

  • You are fluent in German and English and communicate confidently with both internal and external stakeholders.

Why Quantum-Systems:

We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.

About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Python/Django (f/d/m)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at INES Analytics
description_html:
Berlin, 35-40 hours per week, starting immediatly

Do you want to work and help shape the world of work? Then join us and become part of a purpose-driven team working towards a fair and sustainable world of work.

We are INES Analytics – a passionate software start-up in the heart of Berlin. Our mission: to make social sustainability measurable and to support companies in creating fair working conditions.

To drive our mission forward, we’re looking for you: a committed individual to strengthen our team.

A growing team, a clear mission and the chance to help shape real social change through your work – data-driven, practical and forward-looking.

Tasks

You'll own the backend technically and be the go-to person for architecture and infrastructure. You'll write code yourself, help the team grow, and set the technical direction.

In Detail:

  • Own the backend (Python/Django): architecture, code quality, scalability and maintainability
  • Design and evolve REST APIs and integrate external systems
  • Build authentication and SSO (e.g. OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML)
  • Design and run asynchronous processing and background jobs
  • Keep the system fast and scalable as we grow: profiling, query optimization, caching
  • Build a strong testing culture with automated unit, integration and end-to-end tests
  • Review code and pull requests, and set shared engineering standards
  • Mentor junior developers and support their growth
  • Shape and improve reliable deployment, release and CI/CD processes
  • Run and optimize our cloud infrastructure on AWS, containerized with Docker and managed as Infrastructure as Code
  • Set up monitoring, logging and alerting so issues are caught before customers notice them
  • Write and maintain clear technical documentation on architecture, APIs and runbooks
  • Build security and data protection (GDPR) into our architecture and code
  • Work closely with product, design and founders, and bring technical input to the roadmap

Requirements

The following qualifications and experiences are required

* Experience as a tech lead or in a first leadership role

* Several Years of backend development experience with Python and Django

  • Strong PostgreSQL skills (data modeling, performance tuning, migrations)
  • Experience designing and building REST APIs (e.g. Django REST Framework)
  • Hands-on experience with authentication/SSO and integrating external systems
  • Experience with asynchronous task processing
  • A proven track record of improving performance and scaling systems under growing load
  • Solid testing practice (e.g. pytest) and a belief that well-tested code ships faster
  • Confident with Linux, deployment and cloud infrastructure, especially AWS (incl. S3), nginx and Gunicorn
  • Experience with Docker and Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
  • Experience with monitoring and observability
  • A good understanding of SaaS architecture, security and data protection
  • You write clear documentation and value it as part of the work
  • Experience with code reviews and a genuine interest in mentoring others
  • Strong communication skills: you can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical people and make decisions together with them
  • A startup mindset: you're pragmatic, take ownership and handle ambiguity and changing priorities well
  • The drive to grow into a leadership role
  • Fluent English and / or German

Even if you don’t tick all the boxes perfectly, we’d love to hear from you!

Nice to have:

  • Previous startup experience
  • Experience with compliance frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2):

Benefits

  • A small, motivated team where decisions happen quickly
  • A Job with Purpose: Together with our team, you’ll lay the foundation for a future free of discrimination for all employees in companies
  • Flexible work hours with a portion of mobile work
  • Direct access to the founding team instead of anonymous corporate structures
  • Real responsibility from day one—your work directly contributes to the product
  • Insights into building a startup in the field of pay equity and compliance tech
  • Deutschlandticket
  • Table tennis table

We don’t have a never-ending application process. Just send us your CV and a cover letter so we can find out a bit more about you. If it looks like a good fit, we’ll have a a first online chat. And if we hit it off, we’ll take it further: we are doing the second step: welcome to our Berlin office for the technical interview – complete with coffee, a great team atmosphere and maybe even a quick game of table tennis to round things off.

We also embrace diversity within our organisation and are actively committed to equal opportunities. We’re therefore particularly keen to hear from people with different perspectives – regardless of gender, background, sexual orientation, age, disability or religious affiliation.

title: AI Product Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at paddy
description_html:
Das ist kein gewöhnlicher Job. Wir arbeiten an dem, was unsere Gesellschaft zukunftsfähig macht: Bildung. Dafür bauen wir paddy, das Agentic Operating System für Teaching & Learning.

Unsere Mission ist es, Lehrkräfte zu entlasten, Lernergebnisse zu verbessern und die Unterrichtsqualität zu steigern.

Tausende Lehrkräfte und hunderttausende Lernende nutzen paddy bereits. Mit starken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell. Unsere Ambition ist es, den europäischen AI-Player für Bildung zu bauen.

Als AI Product Engineer übernimmst du Probleme unserer Nutzer End-to-End: vom Verständnis des Problems über Architektur, Backend und Frontend bis zum Deployment. Du prüfst, ob die Lösung im Klassenzimmer wirklich funktioniert. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf AI Engineering: Du baust die agentischen Systeme, die paddy ausmachen, und bringst sie zuverlässig, schnell und bezahlbar in Production.

Aufgaben

  • Product Engineering Erfahrung: Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb moderner Webanwendungen mit TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js und React, in einem Produktteam mit echten Nutzer.
  • AI Engineering Know-how: Du hast LLM-basierte Features oder agentische Systeme gebaut und in Production betrieben. Du verstehst Context Windows, Failure Modes von Modellen, RAG, Vektor-Datenbanken und warum Prompts ohne Evals nicht fertig sind. Kein ML Research nötig, aber echtes technisches Verständnis statt Feature-Ebene.
  • Technisches Fundament: Du bist sicher in API-Design, Datenbanken (SQL, NoSQL und Vector), Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) und CI/CD. Dein stärkster Schwerpunkt darf Backend und Architektur sein, aber du bist kein enger Spezialist.
  • Ownership und Urteilskraft: Du kommst mit unterspezifizierten Problemen klar, findest einfache Lösungen für komplexe Fragen und baust Systeme, die auch im Schulalltag funktionieren.
  • AI-native Arbeitsweise: Du nutzt Coding Agents und moderne AI-Tools selbstverständlich, um deinen Output zu vervielfachen, und beschäftigst dich intensiv damit, wie AI Softwareentwicklung verändert.
  • Sprachen: Fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.

Qualifikation

  • Sichtbaren Impact: Du arbeitest am wichtigsten Zukunftsthema unserer Gesellschaft, der Bildung.
  • 70.000 bis 100.000 € Bruttojahresgehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung, plus Equity (VSOP).
  • 100 % Remote-Arbeit. Wenn du lieber ins Büro kommst, steht dir unser modernes Office in Bielefeld offen.
  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum und Ownership sowie direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern und einem starken Product- und Engineering-Team.
  • Ein hohes Budget, solange der Nutzen stimmt.
  • Zeit und Unterstützung für deine Entwicklung, mit Fortbildungsbudget, Coaching und klaren Entwicklungsperspektiven.
  • 30 Urlaubstage und 50 € monatlichen steuerfreien Sachbezug.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und Offsites.
  • Starkes Backing durch erfahrene Investoren und Mentoren.

Benefits

  • Brutaler Impact: Du arbeitest an dem wichtigsten gesellschaftlichen Thema überhaupt: Bildung.
  • 70.000 bis 100.000 € Brutto-Jahresgehalt, abhängig von Erfahrung, plus Equity (VSOP)
  • 100 % Remote: Wenn du lieber vor Ort arbeitest, steht dir unser modernes Office in Bielefeld offen
  • Nahezu unbegrenztes Budget, solange der ROI stimmt
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern und einem starken Product-&-Engineering-Team
  • Sehr viel Gestaltungsspielraum & full Ownership
  • Weiterentwicklung & Lernen: Budget für Fortbildungen, Zugang zu Coaching und klare Entwicklungsperspektiven
  • 30 Urlaubstage, 50 € monatlicher steuerfreier Sachbezug
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und Offsites
  • Starkes Backing: Top-Investoren und Mentoren

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wenn die Kalender passen, können wir den gesamten Prozess innerhalb von fünf Tagen abschließen.

  1. Kennenlernen, Tag 1: Im ersten Gespräch schauen wir, ob es für beide Seiten passt. Wenn ja, vereinbaren wir direkt deinen Probetag.
  2. Probetag mit Case Study, Tag 4: Du arbeitest mit uns an einer echten Aufgabe und stellst anschließend dein Ergebnis vor.
  3. Gespräch mit unserem CEO, Tag 4: Das Gespräch findet am Abend deines Probetags statt.
  4. Teamgespräch, Tag 5: Du lernst die Engineers kennen, mit denen du arbeiten wirst.
  5. Entscheidung, Tag 5: Nach dem Teamgespräch geben wir dir unsere finale Rückmeldung.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Erzähl uns, welche Probleme du gelöst, welche Entscheidungen du getroffen und welche Systeme du in Produktion gebracht hast.

description_html:

Als Tester (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Testautomatisierung übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Qualitätssicherung von Softwarelösungen im Bankenumfeld. Du entwickelst und optimierst automatisierte Testprozesse, baust moderne Testumgebungen im Web-Bereich auf und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team dafür, dass Qualität kein Zufall bleibt.

Über uns

Die CPU Consulting & Software GmbH ist im Bereich Professional Services seit mehr als vier Jahrzehnten als erfolgreicher IT-Dienstleister im Bankenumfeld tätig. Als Tochterunternehmen der CPU Gruppe richten wir unsere Kompetenzen auf die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Softwareprojekten unserer Kunden vor Ort aus.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir zur weiteren Verstärkung unseres agilen Teams einen motivierten Testautomatisierer (m/w/d) in Karlsruhe.

Aufgaben

  • Testautomation in einem agilen Projekt in der Banken- bzw. Finanzdienstleitungsbranche
  • Unterstützung der Fachabteilungen beim Spezifizieren konkreter Testfälle aus Automations-Sicht
  • Durchführung und Überwachung automatisierter Testläufe
  • Integration automatisierter Tests in CI/CD-Pipelines
  • Erstellung und Pflege eines Testkonzepts (Testdesign und Testspezifikation)
  • Koordination und Überwachung der Testfallerstellung
  • Analyse und Dokumentation der Testergebnisse
  • Optimierung und konzeptionelle Weiterentwicklung des Test-Frameworks

Qualifikation

  • Berufs- bzw. Projekterfahrung im Bereich Softwaretest sowie Kenntnisse der entsprechenden Automatisierungs- und Testwerkzeugen (u.a. Playwright, aqua, Jira, Confluence)
  • Grundlegende Java-Kenntnisse und/oder eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung wären wünschenswert
  • Erfahrung in der agilen Softwareentwicklung und in der Bankenbranche von Vorteil
  • Technisches Verständnis, logisches Denken und hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein

Benefits

Zukunftssicherheit:

Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und eine Bezuschussung der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% geben dir Stabilität und Sicherheit für deine Zukunft.

Innovatives und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld:

Wir bieten dir eine langfristige Perspektive in einer Branche, die sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt mit Raum für persönliches Wachstum. Durch gezielte Schulungen erhältst du die Möglichkeit, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und dich in der IT-Welt weiterzubilden.

Attraktive Vergütung:

Wir schätzen deine Leistungen! Im Hinblick auf deine Qualifikationen bieten wir dir eine Vergütung zwischen 60.000 und 85.000 Euro brutto im Jahr, je nach Berufserfahrung auch mehr.

Flexibilität:

Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeitkonto und die Möglichkeit mobil zu arbeiten, um dein Berufs- und Privatleben optimal miteinander zu vereinbaren.

Benefits:

Nutze unser attraktives Hardware- und Bike Leasing sowie den Zugang zu einem Mitarbeiterrabattportal mit 600 namenhaften Unternehmen und spare dabei Geld.

Du findest dich in unserem Profil wieder?

title: Support Engineer Firewall & Netzwerk (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Medialine EuroTrade AG
description_html:
Diese Position ist für unsere Gesellschaft Medialine EuroTrade AG zu besetzen.

Du möchtest Firewalls und Netzwerke nicht nur bedienen, sondern wirklich verstehen?

Bei uns bist Du nicht der Generalist für alles, sondern entwickelst Dich gezielt im Bereich Firewall und Netzwerk weiter. Du analysierst Störungen, konfigurierst Firewalls, Switches und Access Points und betreust Netzwerkumgebungen unterschiedlicher Kunden. Dadurch sammelst Du in kurzer Zeit deutlich mehr praktische Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Herstellern und Umgebungen als in einer klassischen Inhouse-IT.

Als Teil unseres Support-Teams bist Du Ansprechpartner für Netzwerk- und Firewall-Themen, unterstützt unseren Service Desk bei tiefergehenden Fragen und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Support Engineers zusammen. Du musst noch kein Netzwerk-Profi sein – erste praktische Erfahrung reicht. Wir bauen Dein Wissen gemeinsam durch Einarbeitung, Wissenstransfer und Herstellerzertifizierungen aus.

Aufgaben

  • Annahme, Analyse und Bearbeitung von Störungen und Anfragen im Bereich Netzwerk und Firewall per Telefon, E-Mail und Ticketsystem
  • Konfiguration und Betreuung von Firewalls (z. B. Sophos Firewall, Fortinet FortiGate) – Regelwerke, NAT, VPN
  • Administration von Netzwerkkomponenten wie Switches und Access Points (z. B. Ubiquiti UniFi, Fortinet oder Sophos)
  • Einrichtung und Support von Site-to-Site- und Client-VPN-Verbindungen
  • Analyse von Netzwerkproblemen (DNS, DHCP, VLAN, Routing) gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden
  • Dokumentation von Konfigurationen, Änderungen und Lösungen
  • Unterstützung unseres Service Desks als fachlicher Ansprechpartner für Netzwerk- und Firewall-Themen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Support Engineers bei komplexeren Themen und Projekten
  • arbeiten nach definierten Prozessen und Qualitätsstandards

Qualifikation

Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker/in Systemintegration) oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
  • Berufserfahrung im IT-Support, Service Desk oder in der Systemadministration
  • Grundverständnis von Netzwerken (TCP/IP, VLAN, Routing, DNS, DHCP)
  • erste praktische Erfahrung mit Firewalls (z. B. Sophos Firewall oder Fortinet FortiGate) und/oder Netzwerkkomponenten (z. B. Ubiquiti UniFi)
  • gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Windows Client-Betriebssystemen
  • Freude an der Analyse technischer Probleme und Interesse, Dich im Netzwerk- und Security-Umfeld zu spezialisieren
  • Service- und kundenorientiertes Denken
  • selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung im Systemhaus- oder MSP-Umfeld
  • Kenntnisse in Sophos Central, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer oder UniFi Network Controller
  • Herstellerzertifizierungen (z. B. Sophos Certified Engineer, Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA)
  • Grundkenntnisse in Windows-Server-Umgebungen, Active Directory oder Microsoft 365
  • erste Berührungspunkte mit Virtualisierung (Hyper-V oder VMware)
  • ITIL-Kenntnisse oder entsprechende Zertifizierungen
  • Führerschein Klasse B

Benefits

Das erwartet Dich

  • ein abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsumfeld mit unterschiedlichen Kunden, Herstellern und Netzwerkumgebungen
  • gezielte fachliche Spezialisierung im Bereich Firewall, Netzwerk und IT-Security
  • strukturierte Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen
  • geförderte individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Zertifizierungsmöglichkeiten z.B. bei Sophos und Fortinet
  • Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung System Engineering Netzwerk & Security

Weitere Benefits, je nach Standort und Tätigkeitsbereich

  • Mitarbeiterevents
  • Weiterbildung
  • subventioniertes Mittagessen
  • Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice
  • Mentorenprogramm

title: Working Student Integrations

description_html:
About Dataleap

Dataleap (YC S24) is building the agentic operating system for the enterprise. Supported by $3M in funding from YC and industry-leading angels (including Aravind from Perplexity and Rahul Vohra from Superhuman), we’re scaling rapidly with thousands of agents deployed, doubling revenue every month, and facing more enterprise demand than we can handle.

About the Role

We're looking for a working student (20h/week, €30/hour) to co-own our integrations—this is real ownership from the start. You’ll work directly with the founders, ship code to production in your first week, and have an immediate impact on our agentic AI platform.

If you’d like to be part of a fast-growing YC startup, develop deep technical expertise, and potentially join full-time after graduation, we want to meet you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own, design, and implement integrations for our agentic systems end to end.

  • Work directly with the founders and be a key contributor from day one.

  • Ship working software to production quickly—no red tape.

  • Build and improve our tooling and workflows (APIs, automation, AI-first processes).

  • Interface with customers and our core team to understand and solve real-world integration challenges.

  • Shape the technical future of our integrations foundation.

You’re a Fit If

  • You have strong technical skills, especially in Python and TypeScript.

  • You’re comfortable working with APIs and integrating systems.

  • You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and like to take ownership.

  • You care about code quality and delivering value.

  • You’re eager to learn, build, and grow with us—ideally interested in a full-time role after graduation.

What We Offer

  • Competitive student compensation (€30/hour for 20 hours/week).

  • Direct mentorship and collaboration with experienced founders and top engineers.

  • Real responsibility and the chance to see your work in production from week one.

  • The opportunity to transition to a full-time role after graduation.

  • Be part of a high-growth YC startup shaping the future of enterprise AI.

title: Analytics Engineer (w/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Stackfuel
description_html:
Daten sind für uns kein Nebenprodukt, sondern ein zentraler Erfolgsfaktor und das Fundament unserer KI-Strategie. Als Analytics Engineer (m/w/d) bist du die treibende Kraft hinter unserer Datenplattform: Du baust und pflegst die Datenmodelle, auf denen Analytics, Reporting und Data Science im gesamten Unternehmen aufsetzen. Mit robusten, skalierbaren und vertrauenswürdigen Pipelines sorgst du dafür, dass alle Teams auf einer sauberen, konsistenten Datenbasis arbeiten – und machst unser Unternehmen damit messbar datengetriebener und KI-fähiger.

Schwerpunkte deiner Rolle

  • Du entwickelst und pflegst dbt-Modelle und Datenpipelines, die Rohdaten in saubere, dokumentierte und verlässliche Datensätze überführen

  • Du etablierst eine Single Source of Truth für Kennzahlen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Teams mit denselben vertrauenswürdigen Zahlen arbeiten

  • Du designst skalierbare Data-Warehouse-Schemata (dimensionales Modell, Fakten/Dimensionen) mit Fokus auf Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Kosten

  • Du integrierst Daten aus unternehmensweiten Systemen in unseren Data Lake / unser Data Warehouse und führst systemübergreifende Datenflüsse zusammen

  • Du baust und pflegst Dashboards und Reports (z. B. in Metabase), die Fachbereiche zu eigenständigem, datenbasiertem Handeln befähigen

  • Du sicherst und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Datenqualität – inkl. Monitoring, dbt-Tests und klarer Standards für zuverlässige Analytics- und KI-Use-Cases

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Produkt, Engineering und dem Leadership-Team zusammen und übersetzt Business-Fragen in aussagekräftige Metriken und Analysen

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Scientist oder in einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle

  • Sehr gute SQL-Skills sowie praktische Erfahrung mit dbt in Produktionsumgebungen (inkl. Tests, Dokumentation, CI/CD und GitHub-Workflows)

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung, Data-Warehouse-Design, ETL-/ELT-Prozessen und der Auswirkungen auf Skalierbarkeit und Reporting-Performance

  • Praxiserfahrung mit Snowflake (oder vergleichbaren Cloud-DWH-/Data-Lake-Lösungen) sowie einem BI-Tool wie Metabase, Power BI oder Tableau

  • Kenntnisse in Python oder einem ähnlichen Skript-/Analyse-Tool zur tiefergehenden Analyse, Prototyping und Automatisierung

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten und Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären – hohe Service- und Lösungsorientierung im Umgang mit internen Stakeholdern

  • Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Ownership-Mentalität und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Das bieten wir Dir

 

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten
Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung
Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

title: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive (m/w/d) - Germany
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Stackfuel
description_html:
About Multiverse StackFuel

Multiverse x StackFuel is the leading provider of data and AI upskilling programmes in Germany.

In 2025, StackFuel was acquired by Multiverse and we are now building our GTM engine for the enterprise market, to replicate the UK trajectory in Germany. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you get the best of both worlds: StackFuel’s local expertise and product-market fit combined with Multiverse’s GTM leadership, sales playbooks and resources.

Together with our customers, we are redefining how people learn and work, enabling organisations to successfully navigate AI adoption.

Our mission is to open up new career paths for people around the world through practical, future-proof training in data and AI, while helping organisations build the capabilities they need for the digital age.

In this role as an Enterprise Account Executive, you will play a direct and visible part in advancing this mission with our enterprise customers in Germany.

 
 

The role

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you are uniquely positioned to accelerate AI adoption and enablement by delivering a value proposition that sits at the core of German enterprises’ transformation strategies:

  • Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts in Germany.

  • Be responsible for winning new customers and growing existing ones.

  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing.

You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Marketing and Product to bring the best of Multiverse StackFuel to our customers and drive measurable business outcomes for them.

 
 

What you’ll do

  • Ramp up quickly on the Multiverse GTM playbook, supported by market‑leading sales training and a strong development culture.

  • Apply and master the MEDDICC methodology to qualify, manage and scale your pipeline and opportunities.

  • Own new business activities in our most strategic enterprise accounts – including building and nurturing relationships with decision-makers at C‑level and C‑2.

  • Deeply understand your prospects’ challenges around digital transformation, capacity, capabilities and diversity – and position Multiverse StackFuel solutions in a way that clearly links to their strategic priorities and business outcomes.

  • Systematically build champions to win new logos, convert upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and develop accounts into strategic key accounts.

  • Build, grow and manage your own portfolio of strategic existing customers with a long-term, value-based approach.

 
 

What you’ll bring

  • You have 6+ years of closing experience in an enterprise B2B sales environment

  • You have a proven track record in creating and driving new business and are always looking for ways to grow business with your clients through strategic approaches

  • You can build and deliver a thorough end-to-end sales process

  • Experience working with MEDDICC or a similar qualification framework.

  • Proven top performance in previous roles, with strong target orientation and a clear drive to win.

  • You are high energy and driven to continually raise the bar in terms of performance and expectations

  • Fluent German and very good English skills, both written and spoken.

  • Strong interest in technological developments in AI and in how these can be translated into effective learning experiences.

 
 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package with base salary and performance-based commission.

  • Hybrid working culture with modern offices in Berlin, Munich and Düsseldorf.

  • A mission-driven environment at the intersection of education, data and AI.

  • Dedicated budget and time for learning and professional development.

  • Collaborative, supportive team culture with regular feedback and coaching.

 

How we hire

  1. Intro call with Talent

  2. Interview with Hiring Manager, Regional Director

  3. Interview with our VP for Germany, Frank Wenzel

  4. Final Challenge Interview (Panel)

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities and experiences.

title: Mid Market Account Executive (m/w/d) - Germany
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Stackfuel
description_html:
About Multiverse StackFuel

Multiverse x StackFuel is the leading provider of data and AI upskilling programmes in Germany.

In 2025, StackFuel was acquired by Multiverse and we are now building our GTM engine for the enterprise and mid market, to replicate the UK trajectory in Germany. As a Mid Market Account Executive, you get the best of both worlds: StackFuel’s local expertise and product-market fit combined with Multiverse’s GTM leadership, sales playbooks and resources.

Together with our customers, we are redefining how people learn and work, enabling organisations to successfully navigate AI adoption.

Our mission is to open up new career paths for people around the world through practical, future-proof training in data and AI, while helping organisations build the capabilities they need for the digital age.

In this role as an Mid Market Account Executive, you will play a direct and visible part in advancing this mission with our mid market customers in Germany.

 
 

The role

As an Mid Market Account Executive, you are uniquely positioned to accelerate AI adoption and enablement by delivering a value proposition that sits at the core of German mid market’ transformation strategies:

  • Own a portfolio of strategic mid market accounts in Germany.

  • Be responsible for winning new customers and growing existing ones.

  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing.

You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Marketing and Product to bring the best of Multiverse StackFuel to our customers and drive measurable business outcomes for them.

 
 

What you’ll do

  • Ramp up quickly on the Multiverse GTM playbook, supported by market‑leading sales training and a strong development culture.

  • Apply and master the MEDDICC methodology to qualify, manage and scale your pipeline and opportunities.

  • Own new business activities in our most strategic mid market accounts – including building and nurturing relationships with decision-makers at C‑level and C‑2.

  • Deeply understand your prospects’ challenges around digital transformation, capacity, capabilities and diversity – and position Multiverse StackFuel solutions in a way that clearly links to their strategic priorities and business outcomes.

  • Systematically build champions to win new logos, convert upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and develop accounts into strategic key accounts.

  • Build, grow and manage your own portfolio of strategic existing customers with a long-term, value-based approach.

 
 

What you’ll bring

  • You have 3+ years of closing experience in an mid market B2B sales environment

  • You have a proven track record in creating and driving new business and are always looking for ways to grow business with your clients through strategic approaches

  • You can build and deliver a thorough end-to-end sales process

  • Proven top performance in previous roles, with strong target orientation and a clear drive to win.

  • You are high energy and driven to continually raise the bar in terms of performance and expectations

  • Fluent German and very good English skills, both written and spoken.

  • Strong interest in technological developments in AI and in how these can be translated into effective learning experiences.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with MEDDICC or a similar qualification framework.

  • You’re bringing an SDR/BDR background

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package with base salary and performance-based commission.

  • Hybrid working culture with modern offices in Berlin, Munich and Düsseldorf.

  • A mission-driven environment at the intersection of education, data and AI.

  • Dedicated budget and time for learning and professional development.

  • Collaborative, supportive team culture with regular feedback and coaching.

How we hire

  1. Intro call with Talent

  2. Interview with Hiring Manager, Regional Director

  3. Challenge Interview with our VP for Germany, Frank Wenzel

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities and experiences.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, EMEA
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Supercell
description_html:
At Supercell, we craft immersive game worlds that inspire millions. Now, we're looking for a Marketing Manager to bring our games to life across EMEA.

We are seeking a Senior Marketing Manager to join our International Marketing team and to drive regional marketing campaigns and marketing initiatives across the EMEA region. This role requires strong campaign execution, cross-functional collaboration, and in particular a deep understanding of the DACH cultural landscape. The ideal candidate is an operator with exceptional marketing judgement, capable of turning strategy into outstanding regional execution while proactively identifying opportunities to improve campaigns and regional impact.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the end-to-end execution of Supercell marketing campaigns, activations, and initiatives across EMEA.

  • Translate regional marketing strategy into concrete, high-quality regional go-to-market plans.

  • Lead the delivery of campaigns across digital, social, influencer, and partnership channels.

  • Manage timelines, budgets, and scopes to ensure campaigns ship on time and at a high quality bar.

  • Partner closely with local agencies, game teams, marketing strategists, and creatives to ensure smooth execution.

  • Coordinate with creators, agencies, and external partners to deliver integrated campaigns.

  • Oversee production across non-owned channels, events, and activations, ensuring consistency and accuracy.

  • Track campaign performance and player response, sharing insights with stakeholders.

  • Continuously improve execution quality by applying learnings and raising the bar over time.

  • Capture learnings, identify execution improvements and proactively recommend ways to improve future campaigns.

What You Have

  • Strong experience executing marketing campaigns in EMEA and ideally DACH markets, France and the UK - preferably in gaming, entertainment, or consumer brands.

  • Deep understanding of DACH media, culture, and player behavior.

  • Hands-on experience across digital and social marketing, including influencer and creator collaborations.

  • Familiarity with broader media channels such as TV, CTV, audio, and out-of-home.

  • Proven ability to manage complex projects, timelines, and budgets.

  • Experience working with international teams across time zones.

  • Clear and concise communication skills with strong attention to detail.

  • A proactive, adaptable mindset and comfort working in a fast-moving environment.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • Experience working on live games or live service products.

  • Familiarity with Supercell games or a strong interest in mobile and competitive gaming.

  • Experience executing campaigns across EMEA.

Where You'll Be

This is a remote role based in Berlin, Germany.

You'll work closely with teammates in Helsinki, London and partners across the region. This is a globally connected role, with travel expected to Helsinki on a regular basis with occasional international travel.

What Success Looks Like

• First months: You're confidently executing campaigns aligned with global strategy, building strong relationships across teams, and ensuring smooth delivery.

• 6–12 months: Your work is driving measurable impact across awareness, engagement, and player growth. Campaigns feel locally relevant and consistently meet a high quality bar.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

description_html:
About EngFlow

At EngFlow, we help developers save time by accelerating software builds and tests. Our cloud-based, distributed service optimizes developer workflows through remote execution and caching, improving efficiency, productivity, and product quality.

Backed by top investors, EngFlow is redefining how companies build software and ship well-tested products. Our solutions speed up builds by a factor of 10 or more, while our observability platform provides actionable insights for optimization. Founded by key contributors to Bazel, we build tools that empower engineering teams—from startups to Fortune 500 companies—to enhance developer velocity and improve build performance.

Learn more about our mission, culture, and team: EngFlow | Video

We’re looking for an Implementation Engineer to be the technical voice our customers rely on. You’ll support engineering teams during trials and ongoing use, help them integrate and optimize their build workflows, and collaborate with internal teams to ensure a world-class experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for trialing, new, and existing customers—offering guidance as they adopt and scale our platform.

  • Troubleshoot, investigate, and resolve complex issues with build systems, integrations, and environments.

  • Help customers optimize their use of EngFlow’s products and ensure smooth adoption within their developer workflows.

  • Partner with Engineering to surface and track product bugs, performance regressions, and feature feedback from the field.

  • Create and maintain internal and external documentation to improve future support and empower developers.

  • Engage with the broader community via forums, Slack, GitHub, and conferences—representing EngFlow’s voice with empathy and technical clarity.

  • Contribute to a culture of operational excellence through metrics, tooling improvements, and automation.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in software development, technical support, SRE, or developer-facing roles.

  • Strong understanding of developer workflows and build systems (experience with Bazel or Buck/Buck2 is a big plus).

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Go, C++, Java, Python, Rust, or JavaScript).

  • Comfortable in a Linux/Unix environment with experience in tools like Docker, Terraform, or Kubernetes.

  • Familiarity with at least one cloud provider (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure, or OpenShift).

  • Great communicator—able to explain complex technical concepts clearly in writing and on calls.

  • Experience writing or contributing to technical documentation or internal knowledge bases.

  • Customer-centric mindset with a passion for helping engineers solve tough problems.

  • Bonus: experience working with async communication and distributed teams.

Benefits

We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision benefits, 401k/pension, parental leave and generous vacation. The team is fully remote but we enjoy meeting together several times a year at exciting destinations throughout the world. We value getting the work done and having fun while doing it, and have done numerous fun team events such as chocolate, whisky, and tea tastings, monthly team games, escape the room, and other fun events.

Compensation: $80K – $120K • Offers Equity

description_html:
We are looking for a Senior Edge Infrastructure Engineer to own provisioning and operations for our distributed fleet of Linux-based edge devices, cameras, and sensors. You'll replace manual processes with automated PXE-based deployment and configuration management, and support our onsite Installation Engineers by keeping systems deployment-ready and fleet health strong. Senior individual-contributor role.

Why join us

  • Mission with real impact. You'll help the world's most essential companies stay competitive, sustainable, and safe in a world of labor shortages and rising costs.

  • Category-defining moment. With global manufacturers already deploying Almetra and fresh funding, we're scaling fast across Europe and the US.

  • Fleet at scale, real ownership. You'll build the automated backbone behind hundreds of edge devices running in live factories.

  • High bar, high trust. You'll work directly with founders, product, and engineering to define how we deploy and operate hardware at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Own and develop PXE-based provisioning pipelines; automate configuration, testing, and deployment for Linux edge devices

  • Manage the operational lifecycle of the deployed fleet, including monitoring, patching, and remote diagnostics

  • Support Installation Engineers with fully prepared equipment, clear documentation, and remote troubleshooting

  • Manage secure network configurations (routing, VPN, firewalls) for distributed customer environments

  • Define standards for fleet maintenance, reliability, and automated tooling

You are

  • Significant experience administering and troubleshooting Linux systems

  • Hands-on with PXE/network boot and unattended provisioning

  • Proficient in Bash/Python and configuration management/IaC tools

  • Solid networking knowledge (IP, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, Firewalls, VPNs)

  • Experience with WireGuard or similar VPN tools like Tailscale

  • Experience managing distributed fleets at scale

  • Ability to work from Berlin with up to 50% travel to customer sites

  • Professional English proficiency

Nice to have

  • Experience building agentic or LLM-based workflows to generate, adapt, or validate infrastructure and device configurations

  • Familiarity with industrial environments (IoT, cameras, fieldbus protocols)

  • Professional German proficiency

  • a valid driver's license to be able to transport equipment to client site and conduct installations.

Expected to occasionally lift 30kg+


#LI-Onsite #LI-SP

What we offer

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Supportive and inclusive culture that values diversity and promotes the advancement of underrepresented groups within the company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

Ethics⚖: We are committed to developing ethical AI software

Don't meet all the requirements?

Almetra is committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, fair, and inclusive. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds, even if they do not meet every qualification, to submit their application. We firmly believe that having a team with diverse perspectives only strengthens our company and drives innovation. Our commitment also extends to providing an accessible environment for everyone, including those with disabilities. Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the application process or while working with us, and we will do our best to support you.

description_html:
Solutions Engineering Manager - DACH & Nordics

About Neural Concept

Engineering is at an inflection point. The teams defining the next generation of aircraft, electric vehicles, and consumer products are not just designing faster — they are designing fundamentally differently, with AI embedded at the core of their workflows.

Neural Concept builds the Engineering AI platform that makes this possible. We help the world's leading engineering teams accelerate development, improve product outcomes, and scale engineering capacity — turning months of simulation into days, and engineering intuition into data-driven insight.

We work with elite engineering teams in Automotive, Aerospace, High-Tech and Electronics, and advanced manufacturing, where the stakes are high, the complexity is rising, and the pressure to innovate has never been greater. We are changing how engineers work. Come build that future with us.

About the Role

We are looking for a leader who combines deep technical understanding of engineering workflows with the strategic vision and influence to drive large-scale AI transformation in some of the world's most sophisticated engineering organizations.

This role sits at the intersection of technical credibility and commercial strategy. As SE Lead, you will own the pre-sales motion on the region's most strategic accounts — leading discovery, shaping transformation plans alongside Sales, and delivering the technical vision that convinces both engineers and executives that NC is the right long-term partner.

You will also build and develop the regional SE team, setting the bar for what excellent pre-sales work looks like: rigorous discovery, technically grounded statements of work, and demos that don't just impress but inspire confidence in a real engineering future.

Your work will directly shape how Neural Concept wins in the region.

What You'll Do

  • Position NC as a long-term strategic partner and trusted engineering advisor on the region's most strategic accounts, building trusted relationships with engineering leadership and senior stakeholders

  • Lead structured discovery sessions on strategic accounts, framing use cases that are technically feasible and commercially grounded

  • Define the AI strategy and technical roadmap across the regional portfolio, translating NC's capabilities and product direction into credible, customer-specific multi-horizon visions

  • Create and deliver compelling, client-tailored demos and presentations grounded in the client's engineering workflows, technically credible and aligned with the vision

  • Create and co-own the Statement of Work, with deep understanding of the technical building blocks and how these transform the client's existing workflows

  • Prepare and run Steering Committees on strategic accounts, connecting engineering challenges to strategic outcomes

  • Identify expansion and growth opportunities across the regional portfolio, and shape them into well-scoped proposals

  • Lead and develop the regional SE team, setting high standards for discovery quality, demo impact, and SoW accuracy; orchestrate account assignment, manage capacity, and serve as the escalation point on the region's most complex deals

Who we are

YGO is building the AI infrastructure layer for travel.

The way people plan and book trips is changing fundamentally. Fragmented booking journeys are being replaced by personalized, AI-driven experiences. Most travel companies aren't built for this shift. Their systems are complex, disconnected, and were never designed for modern AI.

YGO bridges that gap.

Our modular platform spans AI Search, Recommendations, Packaging, Content Automation, Customer Service, and AI Assistant Integration, enabling travel companies to modernize their customer experience without rebuilding their core systems.

Leading European travel brands including Condor, DER Touristik, Kurzurlaub already rely on YGO. We're backed by Caesar Ventures and the founders of FlixBus, HomeToGo, and GetAway Group, and we've just closed our Series A.

Our ambition is simple:

When someone in travel thinks about AI infrastructure, they should think about YGO first.

Your mission is to make sure that's exactly what happens.

Curious what we're building?

Before you continue, spend two minutes getting to know us.

🎥 Meet YGO

https://youtu.be/mT6NIhmYuMI?si=Jav7gwfgfvvSCwNB

https://youtu.be/RS5Y7fnVadI?si=Cbt6yp_RGOJtIrZR

The role

You'll be our first marketing hire and build the function from the ground up.

You'll turn a technically complex product into stories, proof points, and content that decision-makers actually care about. You'll define how we position ourselves, what we say, where we show up, and how the market perceives us.

This isn't about chasing clicks or generating MQLs.

It's about building reputation.

You think in narratives, not campaigns. In trust, not clicks. In long-term positioning, not short-term metrics.

What you'll do

Positioning & Messaging

Define how the market understands YGO.

  • Build and own our messaging framework across customers, partners, investors, and the broader market.

  • Continuously sharpen our positioning as the AI infrastructure layer for travel.

  • Monitor competitors and industry trends to ensure YGO leads the conversation.

  • Create a consistent narrative used across founders, sales, product, and marketing.

Content & Thought Leadership

Turn complex technology into content people actually want to consume.

  • Write white papers, case studies, opinion pieces, product explainers, and deep dives.

  • Build content formats across LinkedIn, newsletters, webinars, videos, presentations, and whatever you believe works best.

  • Own our website as our most important trust asset.

  • Build a scalable content engine that continuously educates the market.

Proof & Market Trust

Enterprise buyers don't buy claims. They buy evidence.

  • Turn customer conversations into compelling case studies and references.

  • Communicate company milestones, launches, and traction.

  • Build relationships with journalists, trade media, analysts, podcast hosts, and relevant AI and travel communities.

  • Shape YGO's presence at conferences and trade fairs worldwide.

Founder & Company Communications

Help position our founders and YGO as leading voices in AI for travel.

  • Develop LinkedIn content, articles, keynote material, podcasts, interviews, and speaking opportunities.

  • Support investor communication and company-wide storytelling.

Sales Enablement

Help sales build trust faster.

  • Build pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, battle cards, and objection handling material together with our Head of Sales.

  • Ensure inbound interest is handed over cleanly and professionally.

Build the Marketing Function

Build the foundations.

  • Establish our tone of voice, visual identity, workflows, and content processes.

  • Introduce simple metrics that help us understand what's working.

  • Decide where marketing should invest its time and where it shouldn't.

What we're looking for

You have probably spent 4 to 8 years marketing complex B2B software. Maybe SaaS. Maybe AI. Maybe enterprise software.

Titles matter less than whether you've learned how to explain difficult technology in a way enterprise customers understand.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Understands complex products quickly and translates them into compelling stories.

  • Writes exceptionally well in German (native/C2) and English.

  • Enjoys building from scratch and works independently.

  • Has experience in an early-stage startup or building a marketing function.

  • Has a strong feel for B2B communication, especially LinkedIn and long-form content.

Above all, you're curious. You enjoy understanding difficult things and making them easy for others to understand.

This isn't performance marketing, paid acquisition, SEO, or a demand generation role.

Our biggest challenge today isn't creating demand.

It's making sure the market immediately associates YGO with AI infrastructure for travel.

  • Make quick decisions on what to build vs buy vs generate with AI

  • Talk to customers when they report issues and ship fixes same day

📚 Our stack:

  • Backend: Go monorepo (no framework, 3+ services)

  • Hosting: PaaS-managed containers, local setup fully mirrors production via Docker Compose

  • Tools: Jaeger tracing, Betterstack (Logging, Alerting), Redis Asynq queue

  • Databases: PostgreSQL, Redis

  • AI tooling: Claude Code (mandatory)

🚢 Products you will build:

  • An AI search & recommendation engine for major travel enterprises: enterprise integration work (SSO, GDS integrations) with demanding customers

  • A content enrichment API: high-scale, data- and AI-focused backend work

  • Platform: internal tooling, agentic systems, API connections to supplier and business client platforms, data ingestion pipelines, LLM providers

✅ You must have:

  • Ownership mentality with a strive for elegantly simple, high-quality solutions

  • Strive for max quality: you test your own work thoroughly since we have no QA team, everything you ship MUST work

  • Product mindset: you care about WHY we're building something

  • Proven experience using Claude Code, share specific examples

  • Strong Golang experience, you'll review AI's code and you must understand how it works

  • Passion for simple, secure and observable systems which perform well even under massive load

  • Ability to do on-call once in a while to help maintain our platform's reliability & uptime

  • Broad architectural knowledge of building modern full-stack applications

  • Excellent spoken English and good internet connection for daily video calls

  • ⚠️ European or African timezones (±3 hours from CET)

  • Available full-time (40 hours/week)

🌟 Nice to have:

  • Deep expertise in one domain such as SRE/DevOps, databases, security, data science or GDS/travel tech

  • Interest in client-facing work, coordination or product planning

❤️ You are a great fit if you:

  • Think in features and architecture and not single lines of code

  • Get frustrated when development takes weeks instead of days

  • Can spot subtle bugs in AI-generated code quickly

  • Ship fast but always verify it actually works

  • Have shipped real products that customers actually use

  • Think "how can AI build this?" as your first instinct

‼️Things to consider before applying that won't be a match:

  • You've never used Claude Code or similar AI coding tools

  • You're a perfectionist who loves to code

  • You need detailed specs before starting

  • You prefer working to decisions made by an architect or a lead

  • You see AI as a threat rather than leverage

  • You're outside European/African timezones
